why: The student is right that the printed values are only estimates, but says that starting at page 3 would change the ranks. That is the StartPageMatters misconception: the random-surfer chain mixes, so its long-run probabilities are the same from every starting page.

concepts.why: The student correctly says that a short simulation only estimates the ranks, but does not apply this to the counts or to T.
The answer says nothing about repeated vector-matrix multiplication.
The answer makes no claim about running the program.
The answer makes no claim about double values.
The answer does not mention the conditional operator.

concepts.quote: But starting at page 3 would change the ranks.
concepts.why: This applies the wrong rule that the ranks depend on the starting page. In fact the chain mixes, so the limit does not depend on where it starts.
